systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with WHO and other health partners

systems.country_label: Health Resources and Services Availability Monitoring System (HeRAMS)

systems.country_label: Early Warning and Response Network (EWARN); RASED

note: WHO's 2023 report on the health sector; its municipality-level users are health administration and health facility staff working in the Ministry of Health's systems, and the document does not say the municipal councils' own offices are connected or equipped.
